title: Use a PTT button or VOX
breadcrumb: Use a PTT button or VOX

slides.title: Open Devices
slides.html: In Voice, tap Settings, then Devices. On a Samsung XCover7, XCover6 Pro, Tab Active3, Tab Active4 Pro or Tab Active5, the Active Key talks in ATAK with no setup.

slides.title: Scan for your button
slides.html: Tap Scan for PTT devices and press the button on your PTT. When your button shows, tap Use beside it.

slides.title: Volume key and tones
slides.html: Tick Volume-up PTT to talk with the volume-up key, which then no longer changes the volume. Tick PTT tones to hear whether a press goes out, is refused or nears its time limit.

slides.title: Use a headset's talk button
slides.html: Tick Headset PTT to talk with the talk button of a Bluetooth headset. It works with headsets that send a talk event, such as the FalconClaw FC-PTT.

slides.title: Talk from the background
slides.html: Pull down the notifications. Voice push-to-talk is ready means a Bluetooth PTT button, a headset's talk button and the volume-up key talk in the background, even with the phone locked.

slides.title: Talk without a press
slides.html: Tick Voice activation (VOX) to talk without a press, with a headset only. Drag the slider toward Less or More, or tap Default.

slides.title: Check VOX
slides.html: The line under the PTT says what VOX is doing. Voice activation waits for a supported headset until you connect a headset with a microphone.
